'''Chris Fraker''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Wizard World Open]] on 4 August 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Chad McCory's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1081">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-05-chicago-illinois-8-4-2000d1081/ chicago-illinois-8-4-2000], DeckTech (Chad "Luniz" McCory, 5 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-05-chicago-illinois-8-4-2000d1081/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
